meta.title: Everything You Need to Know About Hue Imperial City: Tour, History & Architecture | Vietnam Vlog #47
meta.description:
Welcome to Hue! 

We spent the day exploring the magnificent Hue Imperial City in the pouring rain... We started our journey at the Perfume River, which was absolutely full from all the rainfall, then crossed one of Hue's main bridges completely soaked but excited!

Think of this video as your complete guide to the Hue Imperial City. We take you through every corner, sharing the fascinating history, stunning architecture, and rich culture that defined this royal citadel during its golden age. From the grand courtyards to the intricate details, we cover most of what you need to know before visiting.

After our walking tour, we dried off and enjoyed a delicious Vietnamese lunch at a local spot right near the Imperial City. If you're planning to visit the Imperial City, this is your guide!

Shoutout to our editor @dvreky for helping us with this video!
